meta.lit: Literature check, 20 Nov 2026: none of the 227 appears in six published lists of distant radio galaxy candidates or in the Collier et al. 2014 catalogue of infrared-faint radio sources; SIMBAD attaches no dedicated paper to any of them; no known pulsar lies within 30 arcsec. One lies next to a blazar candidate. No redshift is known for any.
